savings.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_13138 (EO 13138, 64 FR 53879-53881, read once in full): sec. 1 continues sixteen advisory committees to 2001-09-30 (EO 12852 is not among them); sec. 2 reassigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions for those sixteen committees to the listed agency heads; sec. 3(a)-(g) revokes seven committee orders 'which established committees that have terminated and whose work is completed', EO 12852 in sec. 3(f); secs. 4-8 supersede and amend other orders; sec. 9 makes it effective 1999-09-30. There is no savings, pending-matter or exception clause, and the sec. 2 transfer reaches only the sec. 1 committees. Own-residual check, reading EO 12852 in full: it created an advisory Council (members, advice and strategy, subcommittees), agency information duties, unpaid service with travel expenses, funding and administrative support, a 2-year term, and the revocation of EO 12737. It conferred no right or benefit on any person, transferred no function, property or funds to anyone, and fixed no duty that outlives the Council; the reports and strategy it produced are completed acts. research_rationale: EO 12852 (signed June 29, 1993; 58 FR 35841-35842), read in full from the held FR text, created the President's Council on Sustainable Development for 2 years (sec. 4(b)). Four later orders amended it: EO 12855 (1993-07-19, administrative support moved to Interior), EO 12965 (1995-06-27, term to June 29, 1997), EO 12980 (1995-11-17, 29 members), EO 13053 (1997-06-30, 35 members, Interior to Energy, term to February 28, 1999) and EO 13114 (1999-02-25, term to June 30, 1999), each read in full from the held FR text. Their combined effect is that the Council's term ran out by its own terms on June 30, 1999. EO 13138 (signed September 30, 1999, effective that day under sec. 9) lists the Council among committees that 'have terminated and whose work is completed' and revokes the order; it is recorded as a later cleanup event. The first end of every Council clause is therefore 1999-06-30; sec. 4(c)'s revocation of EO 12737 was a one-time act complete on 1993-06-29. The dossier's eleven scopes cover every operative paragraph and were kept. The ofr_catalog search found 8 hits and the U.S. Code and eCFR searches 7 each, consistent with the amendments and the revocation; no order extended the Council beyond June 30, 1999. Savings: see savings_residuals.
